title: Microsoft Copilot Dashboard: weekly and monthly trendlines for adoption and impact metrics
summary: Hold: the briefing describes the dashboard's analysed population as Copilot-licensed employees, but Microsoft also documents insights for Copilot Chat users without a Copilot licence. The trendline functionality, licence thresholds and governance controls are supported; the individual-access path stops early on the correct settings page.

claims.claim: The default minimum group size is 10 employees.

claims.claim: The dashboard's analysed population is employees with an assigned Copilot licence.
claims.quote: For tenants with at least 1 Microsoft 365 Copilot license, the dashboard includes both Microsoft Copilot adoption insights and insights for Copilot Chat by users without a Copilot license, including advanced organizational filters.
claims.fix: Replace the analysed-population sentence in both Risk assessment and Scope with: 'The Microsoft Copilot filter shows insights only for employees who have a Copilot licence.' The cited dashboard page states that filter's scope explicitly; the dashboard also reports on unlicensed Copilot Chat users.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate admin UI or automation switch for weekly and monthly trendlines at the time of writing.

claims.claim: The Viva Insights web app feature policy controls the whole app, including the Copilot Dashboard, at tenant, group or user scope.

claims.claim: Web app access policy changes take effect within 24 hours.
claims.quote: Changes to access policies take effect for the user within 24 hours, unless noted for a specific feature. Changes for Copilot in Viva Engage might take up to 48 hours.

claims.claim: Administrators can turn off automatic dashboard access for eligible senior leaders.
claims.quote: Admins can disable the dashboard auto-enablement control for their entire tenant using PowerShell cmdlets. Disabling the control prevents any user from getting auto-enabled for access to the dashboard.

claims.claim: People with dashboard access can delegate access to other people in their company.
